title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8867: Application Energy 2 cannot use keyboard keys to set the number of pattern
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by cqwnjsdc2212] ### Describe the bug In the Key Binds settings, I changed the pick block key to "N."It was originally the middle mouse button. After this change, I found that I am unable to modify the pattern. The same problem also occurs in the ME interface. Please see my step-by-step demonstration, where I cannot set the quantity using the 'N' key ### How to reproduce the bug Step 1 Step 2 Change the pick block key from middle mouse button to 'N' Step 3 I'm going to press 'N' to modify the amount. Step 4 Press 'N', and the Wood Planks that the mouse pointer is pointing at will disappear. In the me interface, just like Processing Pattern, it is not possible to modify the amount through 'N' ### Expected behavior If I change the pick block to a keyboard key, like 'N', this bug will appear. However. If I change the pick block to a mouse side button, like button 4, this bug will go away. ### Additional details I am not sure whether this is a bug or intentional, but I sincerely hope that AE2 can add a dedicated key in the Key Binds settings. My mouse is experiencing a middle-click double-click malfunction, and I can only change it to another button. ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen? NeoForge ### Crash log https://mclo.gs/veOoBbX [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] This sounds like a duplicate of #8383 which was closed as "not planned". I'll leave this open for now in case you have more input on this. That being said it is confusing for players who see a keybinding that can be changed but does not actually work. Maybe the keybind should be removed altogether to avoid this confusion. Maybe the keybind should be removed altogether to avoid this confusion. I really hope to add a custom button for modify amount I can't write code, but with the help of AI, I found another way. Using software like AutoHotkey, I can bind the middle mouse button to a key on the keyboard Finally, I would like to thank you for answering my questions, but I still hope that AE2 can add a custom key for modifying the amount [comment by mnh48 (none)] so is there any way to set the keybind to keyboard key without using external software like AutoHotkey? since not everyone have permission to install external software or run external exe file my mouse does not physically have a middle button (the scroll wheel is just scroll wheel, it can't be clicked) so I have been relying on keyboard keybind for many other stuff and get stuck with this specific issue when I just got around to play with this mod (has been mainly playing other mods) I have been trying to find a way to set amount in the pattern encoder since the minecraft pick block keybind that I set to keypad - (minus) key is not working here and there's no specific keybind setting for it several other mods have their own settings that also use middle mouse key by default but I could change them to custom keyboard key just fine so I could play them as intended, it's just this mod that is an outlier here and I hope it is fixed [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] It should be fixed by https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8976 but it might not (yet?) have been backported to 1.21.1
